notes.title: Updated Demo Now Live for Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello broom enthusiasts one and all! 🧹💨[/p][p][/p][p]We’re [i]zooming[/i] into Steam Next Fest with a freshly updated demo, now live and ready for you to play! Crescent County will be featured all week, and there's no better time to hop on your motorbroom and take a ride around the Isle of Mor.[/p][p][/p][h2]🚧 [b]What’s new in the demo?[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b]We’ve made a bunch of improvements since our December 2024 build:[/p][list][*][p]New models and set dressing in several locations[/p][/*][*][p]New music tracks for the race[/p][/*][*][p]Updated signage (to stop you getting [i]totally[/i] lost)[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue choices![/p][/*][/list][p]This early tech test includes a tutorial, a race, three delivery missions, and a peek at motorbroom customisation. It's designed to give you a feel for our world, our story, and the unique mechanics at the heart of Crescent County. It's still very much too big an island for what we'll need for the full game, but we wanted to make sure we had good examples of our driving to prove out what our goals were with our Kickstarter (and also to round off the final week with a bang). Speaking of...[/p][p][/p][h2]🎉 [b]Kickstarter Milestone Unlocked![/b][/h2][p]While we’ve been sweeping up Next Fest excitement, [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county"]our Kickstarter has soared past its third stretch goal[/url]! We’ve officially passed [b]£73k[/b], unlocking [b]five new Sigil Stickers[/b] for the game. Thank you so much!![/p][p]Next up, at [b]£78k[/b], all physical reward tiers will receive a [b]FREE premium paper A5 sticker sheet[/b], featuring chibi characters, mini motorbrooms, and doodle stickers that are PERFECT for decorating and scrapbooking. Let’s make it happen![/p][p][/p][h2]📦 [b]Add-Ons Are Here![/b][/h2][p]We've had a lot of community requests for this, and after some planning we've now made Add-Ons live! We’ve just added [b]Kickstarter Add-Ons[/b], including:[/p][p]🎨 a motorbroom zine featuring concept art and game development progress[/p][p]🧢 our 'broom broom' embroidered baseball cap[/p][p]🌟 our original enamel pin[/p][p]🏳️‍🌈 a selection of pride pins![/p][p]If you’re on a digital-only tier and want to grab add-ons, just switch to the new "Add-On Access" tier with shipping included. [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county/posts/4407920"]You can read more in our latest update, here![/url][/p][p][/p][h2]⏳ [b]Five Days Left![/b][/h2][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county"]Our Kickstarter campaign[/url] ends [b]Tuesday 17th June[/b], just after Next Fest wraps up. If you enjoy the demo, please consider pledging to help make this weird, witchy world a reality.[/p][p]Tell your friends, ride your motorbroom, and thank you so very much for all the support you've given us so far 💜[/p][p][/p][p][b]Electric Saint ⚡[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Summer Game Fest + Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p]Hellooooo!🧹[/p][p]Quick status update on the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county"]Kickstarter[/url]: TEN days left and nearly at £70k!! This is an amazing achievement, thank you all so much for your support so far! Now let's get to the news![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Summer Game Fest 2025[/b][/h2][p]We get very very excited whenever Crescent County gets talked about by someone who isn’t us and so can you imagine our excitement to announce that Crescent County will be in TWO showcases during the [b]Summer Game Fest[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/f23214317b7199b268aea867100559bf87c0421f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Starting tomorrow at 17:00 BST is the [b][url="https://www.summergamefest.com/events/wholesome-direct"]Wholesome Direct[/url][/b], an incredible line of games with positive and uplifting vibes. We always love the beauty and variety of the games featured in this showcase and it’s a true honour that Crescent County will be counted amongst them.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/8223c6fcb307c545d872667532e1f856bf1b572a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
And then, straight afterwards starting at 19:00 BST we’ve got the [b][url="https://www.summergamefest.com/events/women-led-games"]Women-Led-Games[/url] showcase[/b]. It shouldn’t be any secret that there are really incredible women working in the Games Industry and many of them take a lead role in creating some of the best games each and every year, much of the work behind Crescent County is thanks to our very own Anna Hollinrake and we can’t wait to see what other creators and projects are showcased alongside Crescent County during this event.[/p][p][/p][p]If you happen to spot us during these showcases feel free to tag us on Bluesky/Twitter/Instagram and tell us how excited you are for Crescent County (we don't mind 😉).[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Next Fest Demo[/b][/h2][p]We're throwing our baseball cap ([url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county/posts/4400004"]which you could get as a Kickstarter reward[/url] 👀) into the Next Fest ring! [/p][p][/p][p]This Next Fest will be active from [b]June 9th and ends on June 16th.[/b] You probably already know this but game demos get so much more coverage and signal boosting during Next Fest and seeing as our Kickstarter is going to come to an end on June 17th, we’d really really appreciate it if everyone reading this could find a moment to hop onto the Crescent County demo during Next Fest and help spread the word about our game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/f560e4d2bc21f2ae0422f068dbced0f2555ad429.png"][/img]  [/p][p]One of our biggest priorities with Crescent County is ensuring that players are quickly able to experience our world and motorbroom driving mechanics as quickly and easily as possible, and with that in mind we’ve developed a very early tech demo of the game. The size of the map is larger than we need and it’s only got a hint of the story but hopefully it’s enough to convince you that this is a world worth spending time in with a wonderful soundtrack and an introduction to the Isle of Mor. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/05e16d470e7004d0817374f15a88f15ff3879149.png"][/img]  [/p][p]Our demo starts with a simple, lo-fi tutorial, followed by two races (with some flirty back-and-forths between the characters) and then 3 delivery missions during which you get to know some of the inhabitants of the island. You’ll chat to the Mor locals, getting to know the main cast of characters a little bit and master your drifting, boosting and gliding skills on the motorbroom. If you finish the demo you can get a little taste of our Motorbroom customisations, allowing you to change the stats on your motorbroom.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/f21f0627da084d508d2c6d6c63ecb1ced386fc65.png"][/img]  [/p][p]To those of you who played our demo when it first released in December 2024, we’ve made some small tweaks and improvements! We’ve got some new set dressing, changed the conversations a bit and added some new race music for you to groove and broom along to.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/dc4c466b04b048a07ec593d7d160f29822bf52b3.png"][/img]  [/p][p]Remember that [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county"]our Kickstarter campaign[/url] is running until Tuesday 17th June, so if you enjoy the demo please consider backing the game on Kickstarter before it’s too late! You’ll be helping our very small team make this dream game come true.[/p][p]That's all for now, keep your eyes peeled for us during the showcases and get ready for an exciting week of games demos during Next Fest![/p][p]Broom'n'Zoom
Electric Saint ⚡[/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter funded in under 24 hours! Stretch goals! London Comic Con!
notes.notes:
It’s been just over a week since [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]we launched our Kickstarter[/url], and a LOT has happened. Let’s get to the biggest news first though!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/0b35631b112f415bd84c82654407b1a4d54ee1cb.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Crescent County hit its funding goal in under 24 hours.[/h2]

This is an absolutely unbelievable achievement and we are so, so thankful.

For a game idea that started out so small, and so hopeful, and seemed so utterly impossible to make real, we’re now sitting at 62k with 20 days left to go. From all of us at Electric Saint, thank you so much for all your cheering and enthusiasm and support. We crossed the line at 16:37, with more than an hour to left on the clock!

It was also CARNAGE in the Discord as we speculated on whether we’d cross the finish line before the 24 hour mark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/b7a8ed5653291509d2938a094b9243ab11314b73.png[/img]

We were screaming, we were cheering, there was much keyboard smashing. We didn’t think it was likely to happen in 24 hours at ALL, but the sheer momentum of this community’s energy carried us forward. With delight and yelling and memes. Sending you all SO MUCH LOVE!!!! And [url=https://discord.gg/mJkBhmMd8E]hop into the Discord[/url] if you’d like to get involved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/c79f17328ae3a34a277f35abc9ff7d6303212fbd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/c514b131cfd102ab9c5eb073940d71110dafb604.png[/img]

We’ve also hit our first stretch goal:

[h2]£60k: Expanded Driving Radio![/h2]

Music is such a vital moodsetter for our game, and we want to have as many vibey tracks in Crescent County as possible. With the extra funding, we can pay for more music for our in-game radio/background music (not the Spotify playlist)! Alongside creating more original music to add to our OST, we also want to license music from existing artists. We'd love for CC to act as a literal vehicle for music discovery, especially for new and upcoming local bands! This is something we're already doing in a small way, but we want to do it a WHOLE LOT MORE!

Our next stretch goal iiiiis:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/eedb8afde493a3ce2cd7abb67cb003f6c0bddbb9.png[/img]

[h2]£67k: Longer Dates, More Kissin![/h2]

With the extra funding we can put more resources and assets into our romances with Aster. Bo, Jessica, and Mara, which includes more animations (taking Jessica on a romantic ride on the back of your broom, anyone?), better date locations (bonfires on the beach, mycology research with Aster, light breaking and entering with Mara), and expanded dialogue options. We really want to create memorable romantic moments with emotional heft (any maybe even some yearning), so [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]this funding will really help us achieve that![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/bed009a3eb7981deed4d33bd005f577a6fa63d64.png[/img]

Finally, we rolled straight from our launch into demoing our game to the public at MCM London Comic Con! [i]This may have been one of the most exhausting things Anna has ever done.[/i] However, with the support of some incredible booth buddies, it was a wonderful success!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/8067df51ac4a11eb9dbdf6cbe2d1d34793148264.png[/img]

We got some amazing demo feedback that we're going to be applying alongside what we've received in our Discord demo feedback channel, and we got to have a lot of wonderful moments of long-time supporters of Anna's illustration realise that the painting on their wall [i]is a video game now.[/i] Also Gengar enjoyed the wares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/3f46693e08e4b08b36c46da78c58ee456f14a4d4.png[/img]

To top all of this off, one of our favourite motorbroom enthusiasts Alex customised a Sony Sports CD Walkman to look like a piece of witch-tech straight out of Crescent County! Honestly this is hands down one of the coolest things EVER and it has pride of place on our shelf, forever. Look!! At this!!! We must find a way to reference it in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/acadf8cc962274669695570f068348ef52e13cad.png[/img]

Anyhow, LOTS HAPPENING, LOTS MORE TO COME. We haven't even gotten into the Crescentsonas yet! As always, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]please tell your friends about our Kickstarter,[/url] please back us if you're interested, we've got so much more that we want to do! It's happening, gang, it's happening!

notes.title: Our Kickstarter is LIVE!!!
notes.notes:
Hello! We're going to get right to it!!

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]Our Kickstarter campaign for Crescent County has just gone live!![/url][/h1]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/1e755bf44f261f369bf87be530226637b1fbe4e3.png[/img][/url]

This means that you can now head to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]HERE[/url] and help us make our dream game! Along the way you can nab yourself all sorts of cool swag, we’ve got digital soundtracks, ZINES, pins, patches, and even BASEBALL CAPS.

For those of you who just want to see a great game get made, please consider spreading the word of our Kickstarter or just chipping in a small amount to help us number go big.

It’s been incredibly difficult canvasing the entirety of the Games Industry for funding on this project, toeing the line between ‘needing to look cool and capable so people have confidence in us’ and ‘wanting to scream in to the void about how hard it is for indies right now’. The success of this Kickstarter will absolutely transform what we’re able to deliver as a team.

So yea. We hope you like the campaign and thank you to everyone who’s helped us get this far, you mean the world to us.

ES ⚡

notes.title: Crescent County Kickstarter Launch Date Announcement 👀
notes.notes:
If you’ve had your ear to the ground, well, first of all, are you ok? And secondly, you’ve probably already heard that we’re about to launch our Kickstarter campaign! We’re feeling particularly brave today so we’ve mustered the courage to share another piece of information with you all: Our launch date! Truly, this is sacred knowledge, but we trust you with it.

So here it is!
The big announcement!
The date!

[h2]THE CRESCENT COUNTY KICKSTARTER LAUNCHES [b]TUESDAY 20TH MAY!![/b][/h2]

Assuming we timed that correctly, a huge explosion of fireworks and applause should have been audible in your imagination.

So yeah. There it is. A date! THE date!
When the Kickstarter goes live you’ll be able to back the project and see what perks and goodies we’ve lined up for anyone that pledges to the campaign. 

Until then, please do help us spread the word of the campaign - it really helps us if people [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]follow the pre-launch page.[/url] And [url=https://discord.gg/mJkBhmMd8E]come hang out in our Discord too, if you fancy it![/url]

Thank you for your continued support in motorbrooms, friend kissing and beautiful sunsets.

notes.title: Crescent County is an open-world "witch-tech" delivery life-sim where you travel around on a motorised broom
notes.notes:
Witch-tech? That's a new one. Crescent County has a really fun idea and some lovely visuals too. It's a delivery life-sim where you move to a witch-tech island and explore its painterly open world on the back of your scrappy, souped-up motorbroom.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/12/crescent-county-is-an-open-world-witch-tech-delivery-life-sim-where-you-travel-around-on-a-motorised-broom

notes.title: Steam deck build! Future plans!
notes.notes:
Hey! The demo's been out for a few days and life on our [url=discord.gg/4MDq9rpsF2]discord[/url] has never been the same! Check out the #demo_discussion channel for some discussion on what comes next, and also some fun debug features you can play around with while you wait for the next update.

We're currently working on performance, and we're aware of some issues, in particular on AMD hardware. Overall, improving how the game runs is our next priority after getting all your feedback about the driving and the [i]vibes[/i].

In the meanwhile, we've released our first steam deck native build! It's still in an early stage and has a couple of issues, but it's quite fun brooming around on the steam deck already! Give it a go if you're a steam deck lover like we are.

notes.title: Crescent County demo is LIVE!!
notes.notes:
Hello - If you’re reading this then it means we’ve managed to accomplish the statistically unlikely: We released our Demo! We overcame fate, we overcame the odds and most of all: We overcame a bunch of bugs and errors in Unreal Engine to bring YOU, a (hopefully) playable demo of Crescent County.

Now wait a second, before you click that “install” and “provide scathing commentary on this unfinished piece of work” button, lets just manage some expectations:
[list]
[*]Demo is about half an hour long!
[*]Steam Deck is [b]not supported right now[/b] as we're having some performance issues, but we're working on it!
[*]Game very very very not finished (we just hate keeping secrets)
[*]Bugs definitely exist in the game!
[/list]

That said, we are VERY proud of what we’ve made so far and we want to share our motorbroom driving experience with you all. We know many of you are excited to explore our island whilst gliding, drift boosting and sweeping your friends off their feet (metaphorically, for now) - that’s exactly what we hope to offer in this demo.

Finally - If we’ve said it once: We’ve said it once or twice. [url=https://discord.com/invite/mJkBhmMd8E]Join our Discord Server.[/url] The development team are in there posting memes of their own characters, we have people making fanart, we have regular chats about DnD and our Community Manager regularly overshares his latest JRPG or anime obsessions. It’s paradise. We’ve also got a channel (called the “Bug Hotel”) where you can document any bugs or glitches you come across and we jump onto the voice chat to show-off development secrets or co-stream announcements and news about the game.

December is quite a packed month so you MIGHT hear from us again before the year is up, who knows 

(we're knows, we're also in the following showcases this upcoming week!! 👇👇)

Day of the Devs (Dec 9th, 12:00 EST / 17:00 GMT)
Women Led Games (Dec 11th, 19:00 EST / 00:00 GMT (midnight of the 11th and 12th))
The Game Awards for People Who Can't Afford the Game Awards (Dec 13th, 12:00 EST / 17:00 GMT)

Hopefully we'll catch you on the Discord sometime soon!

notes.title: PC Gamer's Most Wanted, plus DEMO!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got some news that has absolutely SWEPT us away (haha brooms)! Crescent County has been VOTED as one of PC Gamer's MOST WANTED video games of 2024! The wise council of PC Gamer judges* have, with pin-point accuracy, determined that Crescent County is in the TOP 25 Most Wanted games. WILD! Of all the other games out there??? We’re possibly more wanted than the Crazy Taxi remake! What timeline is this??

You can check out our chaotic developer message that we put together for the showcase below!

[previewyoutube=_ESysPLSlDA;full][/previewyoutube]

So first off, just a big ol’ THANK YOU. Thank you to all of you who have shown even a smidgen of curiosity about this game and especially thank you to those of you who have joined our Discord, followed our socials and cheered us on along the way.

We’ve had the pleasure of taking Crescent Country to Comic Con as well as chatting to some of you in our Discord server and it’s just been fantastic to connect with your excitement for our aggressively earnest girl-kissing-broom-riding-drift-boosting video game.

BUT THAT’S NOT ALL - We’ve got a cheeky little December treat for you all. We are!!! Dropping a DEMO!!! A Real. Playable. Installable. DEMO! It's still very early days though - the game is nowhere near finished but we’re ready to at least showcase one of the central mechanics of the game: The Motorbroom. 

In this demo you’ll be able to zoom your way around the island and get a real feel for what Crescent County will be when you’re not furnishing your crash-pad or DMing your crush whilst crashing into a tree.

The demo will be available to play from December 8th. Please jump in, do some zoomin’ and join our Discord to let us know what you think!

*Electric Saint Creative Director, Anna Hollinrake was part of the council of judges but wasn’t allowed to vote for her own game. This seems very reasonable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/6c41b444b9a207ae17cabf070c166844739f54a8.jpg[/img]
